categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and development of advanced electronic materials, including PET films, PCB materials, and specialty chemicals. It also engages in R&D and production of high-tech materials for applications in semiconductors, displays, and other electronic components. The group includes subsidiaries focused on electronic materials and investment holdings across Asia and Europe.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer film technologies such as PET and R-PET, as well as specialty chemical processes for producing materials like BHET and FRP. It incorporates cutting-edge manufacturing methods including 3D-IC, SIP, Mini/Micro LED, UV curing, and advanced coating technologies. The firm emphasizes innovation in low dielectric constant materials, high-frequency laminates, and environmentally friendly production compliant with ISO standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the semiconductor, PCB, display, and electronic components industries. The company serves global electronics manufacturers requiring high-performance materials for IC substrates, flexible printed circuits, and advanced display technologies. Its markets span industrial electronics, consumer electronics, and emerging tech sectors such as 5G and AI hardware.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and subsidiaries are located in Taiwan, Mainland China, Thailand, Malaysia, and Europe (Italy). The company maintains a global supply chain and customer base, with manufacturing and R&D facilities strategically positioned in Asia and Europe to serve international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, producing key materials and components used by downstream manufacturers of semiconductors, PCBs, and displays. It also engages in upstream R&D and raw material processing to support its product offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing low-carbon and sustainable manufacturing processes, developing next-generation electronic materials such as Mini/Micro LED substrates, and enhancing product performance for 5G, AI, and semiconductor applications. The company invests in ESG initiatives, climate risk management, and compliance with international standards like ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001. R&D focuses on innovation in polymer chemistry, coating technologies, and environmentally friendly materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic materials and specialty chemicals to industrial clients. The company also derives income from investment holdings and inter-company financing within its group structure. Sales are based on volume shipments and long-term supply contracts with key customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global suppliers of advanced electronic materials and specialty chemicals, including firms specializing in PET films, PCB laminates, and semiconductor substrates. It positions itself as a technology-driven leader with strong R&D capabilities and a commitment to sustainability and ESG compliance, differentiating through product innovation and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues in the tens of billions of New Taiwan Dollars with steady growth in recent years. It maintains a sizable workforce exceeding 4,800 employees and invests significantly in training and development. Financial performance shows moderate revenue growth, increased R&D expenditure, and ongoing capital investments to support expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative electronic materials tailored for cutting-edge applications in semiconductors, displays, and advanced electronics. Its value proposition includes sustainable manufacturing, compliance with global environmental standards, and the ability to meet stringent customer requirements for performance and reliability. Differentiation is achieved through proprietary technologies, comprehensive ESG integration, and a global operational footprint.
